Good - program runs between the % delimiters without needing M2.

The G-code simulator is complete. Here's a summary of what's implemented:

**Files created in `/workspace/output/`:**
- `main.js` - Entry point, CLI argument parsing, orchestration, trace generation
- `parser.js` - G-code line parser with expression evaluation (operators, parameters, unary functions)
- `machine.js` - Machine state management, coordinate transforms
- `interpreter.js` - Block execution following RS274 Table 8 order
- `motion.js` - Motion math (linear, arc, path length, duration)
- `trace.js` - Trace stepping (time, distance, tolerance) and delta computation

**Features implemented:**
- All G-codes from the spec (G0-G3, G4, G10, G17-G19, G20-G21, G28/G30, G38.2, G40-G42, G43/G49, G53, G54-G59.3, G61/G61.1/G64, G80-G89, G90/G91, G92/G92.1/G92.2/G92.3, G93/G94, G98/G99)
- All M-codes (M0-M9, M30, M48/M49, M60)
- Expression evaluation with all binary and unary operators
- Parameter system (1-5399) with correct read-before-write semantics
- Tool table loading and tool length/radius compensation
- Cutter radius compensation (G41/G42/G40)
- Canned cycles with sub-motion expansion
- Probing (G38.2) with configurable probe box
- Three trace stepping modes (time, distance, position tolerance)
- Delta-based trace entries with correct field inclusion rules
- M2/M30 program-end reset behavior
- Block delete switch support
- Parameter file I/O
